label: Space Weather → TAK
info:
One status marker colored by the current geomagnetic storm level (NOAA G-scale from the Kp index), with active space weather alerts in the remarks. Handy for judging HF conditions.

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (https://www.swpc.noaa.gov/). Updates every 5 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. The marker's position is set at the top of the Build status CoT function.
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/space-weather
